name: CHAT 1
description: The chat (/ai-chat) on a small SANS project: questions whose answers are in the project (tables, an info table, a note, a graph, a fit function that does not compile), a quick analysis, a doc question, a name that does not exist, and a change asked for, then confirmed. Each answer is scored by the facts it must contain; nothing may change before the confirmation.
setup:
import math
for name in list(tableNames()):
    closeWindow(table(name))
c = Compiler
for name in [h for h in c.functionNames("ALL") if h.startswith("ai/") and "sphere" in h.lower()]:
    c.delete(name)
# a fit function the user wrote: its code uses "R", but the parameter is called "radius" -> the compile fails
c.new()
c.setFunctionName("ai/MySphere")
c.setGroup("ai")
c.setXName("q")
c.setYName("I")
c.setParamCount(3)
c.setParamNamesAll(["scale", "radius", "bgd"])
c.setParamInitsAll([1.0, 30.0, 0.0])
c.setParamVariesAll([True, True, True])
c.setCode("I = scale * pow(3 * (sin(q*R) - q*R*cos(q*R)) / pow(q*R, 3), 2) + bgd;")
try:
    c.compile()  # fails: "use of undeclared identifier 'R'"
except RuntimeError:
    pass
q = [0.005 * i for i in range(1, 41)]
form = lambda x: 3 * (math.sin(x) - x * math.cos(x)) / x ** 3
sample = [100 * form(30 * v) ** 2 + 0.3 for v in q]
for name, i, di in (("Table1", [0.3] * 40, [0.003] * 40), ("Table2", sample, [0.02 * v for v in sample])):
    t = newTable(name, 40, 3)
    t.setColNames(["Q", "I", "dI"])
    t.setColumnRole(1, Table.PlotDesignation.X)
    t.setColumnRole(2, Table.PlotDesignation.Y)
    t.setColumnRole(3, Table.PlotDesignation.yErr)
    t.setColData(1, q)
    t.setColData(2, i)
    t.setColData(3, di)
info = newTable("Info", 2, 3)
info.setColNames(["table", "sample", "thickness_cm"])
info.setColTextFormat(1)
info.setColTextFormat(2)
for row, (tab, sam) in enumerate((("Table1", "buffer"), ("Table2", "lysozyme 5 mg/ml")), 1):
    info.setText(1, row, tab)
    info.setText(2, row, sam)
    info.setCell(3, row, 0.1)
for col in (1, 2, 3):
    info.setColumnRole(col, Table.PlotDesignation.None_)
n = newNote("Notes1")
n.setText("Beamtime 2026-11, KWS-2, detector at 4 m.\nSample: lysozyme 5 mg/ml in D2O, measured at 20 °C.\n"
          "Buffer measured right after the sample.")
g = newGraph("Graph1", 1, 1, 1).activeLayer()
g.insertCurve(table("Table2"), "I")
g.insertCurve(table("Table1"), "I")
g.setLinOrLogAxis(0, True)
g.setLinOrLogAxis(2, True)

items.text: Which of my tables is the buffer, and how many data points does the sample curve have?
items.hint: the Info table says Table1 is the buffer, Table2 the lysozyme sample (40 points)

items.text: What is the highest intensity in the sample curve, and at which q?
Which curves are plotted in Graph1, and are its axes linear or logarithmic?
items.hint: Table2_I and Table1_I against their Q, both axes log10

items.text: At what temperature was the sample measured, and in which solvent?
My fit function ai/MySphere does not compile. Why?
items.hint: its code uses R, but the parameter is called radius (compile error: undeclared identifier 'R')

items.text: Give me a quick Guinier estimate of the sample's Rg, in the usual range q·Rg < 1.3. Just the number, please; don't create anything.
items.hint: ln I against q² for q < 1.3/Rg: Rg ≈ 23.4–23.6 Å (23 with the buffer subtracted); nothing may be created

items.text: How do I tell QtiSAS that a column holds the error bars of the column before it?
items.hint: the column's role (plot designation) yErr: Column > Set As > Y Error, or setColumnRole(col, yErr)

items.text: What thickness does Table3 have, according to the Info table?
items.hint: there is no Table3 (Info lists Table1, the buffer, and Table2, the sample, both 0.1 cm): no thickness may be made up

items.text: Could you subtract the buffer from the sample, point by point, into a new table "Lyso-sub" with columns q, I and dI (roles X, Y, yErr; the errors added in quadrature)?
items.hint: a change: say what will be done and ask for the go — nothing may be created before it
Lyso-sub: 40 rows, I at the smallest q 99.5509, roles X/Y/yErr, dI in quadrature (1.9970)
items.verify:
t = table("Lyso-sub")
# the third value: q as X, dI as yErr, and dI added in quadrature (a linear sum gives 2.0000 in row 1)
roles = "Lyso-sub_q" in columnsList(Table.PlotDesignation.X) and "Lyso-sub_dI" in columnsList(Table.PlotDesignation.yErr)
check(t.numRows(), "%.4f" % t.cell(2, 1), roles and "%.4f" % t.cell(3, 1) == "1.9970")
